Title: Workbook does not identify its ATL105 version, producer, date or document ID
Detail: The single sheet has no version, owner, date or source column. This validation assumes ATL105 2026-3, the version of the Test Solution oracle.
Disposition: Add specification version, producer, date and an ATL105 section/element reference column.

Title: Field mappings that contradict ATL105
Detail: 5 lines would test the wrong field: TS-002.V1 'Element 51 present for manual entry' -> Element 12 carries the MMYY expiry for a manually entered account; TS-004.V1 'Processing Code = Purchase/Capture (020)' -> Element 78 Prompt Code = 0020 (transaction type 0, card type 020); 0020 alone does not prove Mastercard; TS-010.V1 'Element 24 present' -> Element 2 Account Number present; TS-016.V1 'Element 80 present' -> Element 86 Sequence Number present; TS-022.V1 'Element 6 received for approval' -> Element 5 Approval Number received in the approved response. 4 of 6 element citations name the wrong Chapter 13 element.
Disposition: Correct the field mapping before any test is derived.
